name: Waveform Free
summary: A free DAW you can record into and use as a plug-in host.
requirements: The product page says there is no track-count restriction and the download does not expire. Optional expansion packs cost extra. This is one DAW, not a separate listing for each built-in effect.
restrictionLabel: Free edition. Paid add-ons are separate.
sourceNote: Product page, 8 Nov 2026: “no track-count restrictions or trial expiry”. Page title names mac, PC, and Linux.

name: GarageBand
summary: A free recording studio for Mac, with instruments included.
platformLabel: Mac only. Requires macOS 15.6 or later.
requirements: The App Store listing says Free and Only for Mac. It is not Windows software. Download uses an Apple account. Included amps and instruments are part of GarageBand, not separate offers.
sourceNote: US App Store listing, 8 Nov 2026: price 0 USD, “Only for Mac”, “Requires macOS 15.6 or later”.

name: Cakewalk Sonar free tier
summary: A free Windows DAW tier. Premium membership features are separate.
platformLabel: Windows. A Mac or Linux build was not confirmed.
requirements: The site says the free tier is available with a free BandLab account and is installed with Cakewalk Product Center. Overloud TH-U inside Sonar is listed as demo mode, not a full free TH-U. Membership features are paid.
restrictionLabel: Free account. TH-U is a demo here.
sourceNote: cakewalk.com/sonar, 8 Nov 2026: free tier with a free BandLab account; TH-U amp simulator listed as Demo Mode on the comparison, not Full Edition.

name: Audacity
summary: A free editor and recorder for guitar takes. Not a full MIDI DAW.
requirements: The official site calls Audacity free and open source. Use it to record and edit. It is not listed here as a full production DAW, and it is not a substitute for a plug-in host if you need every plug-in format.
restrictionLabel: Editor and recorder, not a full DAW.
sourceNote: audacityteam.org, 8 Nov 2026: page title “Free, Open Source Audio Editor and Recorder”. Already in the catalogue as a free entry.

name: Blue Cat's Free Amp
summary: A freeware guitar amp sim with a standalone app, so a paid host is not required.
platformLabel: Windows and Mac. Standalone app and plug-in.
requirements: The product page says the plug-in is entirely free, with no registration, dongle, or newsletter. It is an amp sim. It does not claim to include every cabinet or to replace a separate impulse-response loader.
sourceNote: Blue Cat Free Amp page, 8 Nov 2026: “entirely free : no registration required, no dongle, no newsletter”. Standalone application and plug-in formats for Mac and Windows.

name: AmpliTube 5 CS
summary: The free Custom Shop edition. This is not the paid AmpliTube 5.
platformLabel: Stand-alone or plug-in. Confirm the installer for your system.
requirements: IK says the included gear is yours free, forever, stand-alone or as a plug-in. Other Custom Shop models are a separate catalogue and can be time-limited demos. Those demos are not part of this free listing. An IK account is part of their authorisation flow.
restrictionLabel: Free edition. Paid gear demos are separate.
sourceNote: AmpliTube 5 CS page, 8 Nov 2026: “They’re yours free, forever, to use stand-alone or as a plug-in”. The paid AmpliTube 5 catalogue entry is a different product.

name: Guitar Rig 7 Player
summary: The free Player edition. This is not Guitar Rig 7 Pro.
platformLabel: See the Native Instruments page for the current system requirements.
requirements: The page titles it a free amp simulator and effects rack, with amp simulation, matched cabinets, 26 effects and tools, and presets. Pro-only features are not included. Download is from Native Instruments.
sourceNote: Native Instruments page, 8 Nov 2026: title “Guitar Rig 7 Player - Free amp simulator and effects rack”, and copy describing matched cabinets, 26 effects and tools.

name: Amplifikation Lite
summary: Kuassa’s free amp. This is not Amplifikation Vermilion.
platformLabel: PC and Mac. VST and Audio Unit.
requirements: The product page prices it at $0 and calls it free. It needs a compatible plug-in host. A free host on this page can be that host. It is not a free licence for Amplifikation Vermilion.
sourceNote: Kuassa product page, 8 Nov 2026: “easy-to-use and FREE! $0” and “PC & Mac – 32-bit & 64-bit – VST – Audio Unit”.

name: NadIR
summary: A free impulse-response loader for cabinet simulation.
platformLabel: Windows and macOS. VST, VST3, AU, and AAX builds are listed.
requirements: Ignite describes NadIR as a dual impulse-response convolver for guitar and bass cabinet simulation. It needs a plug-in host or compatible hardware. It does not include a cabinet library. Bring impulse responses whose licence allows you to use them. This page does not redistribute any.
restrictionLabel: Loader only. You supply the IRs.
sourceNote: igniteamps.com, 8 Nov 2026: NadIR “is a zero latency, dual Impulse Response (IR) convolver” for cabinet simulation, with Windows and macOS downloads. The same page calls the plug-ins free software.

name: Valhalla Supermassive
summary: A free delay and reverb. This is not a free ValhallaRoom.
platformLabel: Windows and Mac. VST, VST3, AAX, and AU.
requirements: The shop page says Free and links to downloads. It needs a plug-in host. It is a different product from the paid ValhallaRoom in the catalogue.
sourceNote: Valhalla Supermassive shop page, 8 Nov 2026: “Free! Go to Downloads.” Version notes name Mac and Windows builds and VST, VST3, AAX, and AU.

name: Kilohearts Essentials
summary: A free bundle of effects. Not an amp, and not their paid instruments.
platformLabel: System requirements are on the Kilohearts page.
requirements: The page lists the bundle as free and says the effects are free with an account. Listed component prices on that page are $0. A plug-in host is required. Paid Kilohearts instruments are not included.
sourceNote: Kilohearts Essentials page, 8 Nov 2026: “Includes 34 products” with bundled prices shown as $0, and “free with your account”.

name: TONEX 2 CS
summary: The free TONEX edition. This is not the paid TONEX 2 collection.
platformLabel: Mac and PC, as named on the product page.
requirements: The page says to start free with TONEX 2 CS, described as Free Unlimited, or choose a paid edition for a larger Premium Tone Model collection. Premium collections are not included. An IK account is part of their authorisation flow. Community tone models have their own terms.
restrictionLabel: Free CS edition. Premium models are paid.
sourceNote: TONEX product page, 8 Nov 2026: “Start free with TONEX 2 CS - Free Unlimited, or choose a paid edition for a larger collection of Premium Tone Models.”

name: Neural Amp Modeler
summary: A free and open-source amp-modeling plug-in. Models and cabinet IRs are separate.
platformLabel: Plug-in. Installer platforms are on the project site.
requirements: The official site calls it a free and open-source amp modeling plug-in. It needs a plug-in host. Use models and cabinet impulse responses whose licences allow it. Capturing a real amp needs that hardware. This listing does not count community models one by one.
restrictionLabel: Open source. Models and IRs are separate.
sourceNote: neuralampmodeler.com, 8 Nov 2026: page title “Highly-accurate free and open-source amp modeling plugin”. Already in the catalogue as a free entry.
